p01.title: Lüpük
p01.subtitle: Brand identity and e-commerce UI for a retro-pop candy shop.

p02.title: Project Summary
p02.lead: Lüpük is a concept candy and snack storefront built around physical bag cues rather than sterile white grids.
p02.body1: The project covers brand naming, four vector logo variants, a six-color packaging system, and a working React storefront with 24 products.
p02.body2: Every price, shipping note, and store flow is a demo placeholder. No real transactions, inventory, or customer metrics exist.

p03.title: The Core Idea
p03.lead: Make a browser card feel like a paper-sealed snack pouch picked off a corner shop rack.

decisions.head: Hard Ink Outlines
decisions.text: Replace soft drop shadows with 2px cocoa-ink borders (#2B1410) and flat offset shadows.

decisions.head: Color-Coded Bags
decisions.text: Assign one saturated flat color per candy type so shoppers scan by flavor family.

decisions.head: Tactile Bag Cues
decisions.text: Use zigzag heat-seal edges, starburst price stickers, and mono weight tags on every card.

p03.diagramCaption: Abstract system diagram: pouch silhouette translated into UI card anatomy.

p04.title: Brand & Logo System
p04.lead: A five-letter invented Turkish wordmark built to stay legible from a 24px favicon to a full-width footer.
rules: Keep at least 16px clear space around horizontal lockups.
Never add gradients, blur shadows, or stretch proportions.
Always pair dark cocoa ink (#2B1410) or cream (#FFF8EE) for contrast.

p05.title: Color System
p05.lead: Warm cream surfaces hold 60% of the viewport so saturated candy colors stay punchy without glare.

p06.title: Typography
p06.lead: Four open-source families with full Turkish glyph support (ş, ğ, ı, İ, ç, ö, ü).

families.name: Baloo 2
families.note: Replaced Fredoka after testing revealed missing Turkish ş/ğ glyphs.

families.name: Plus Jakarta Sans
families.sample: Sert şekerden tuzlu kıtırlara 24 çeşit tek vitrinde.
families.note: Calm geometric sans for long descriptions and form fields.

families.name: Fraunces (Italic)
families.note: Used sparingly inside hero pills and quote accents.

families.name: JetBrains Mono
families.note: Replaced DM Mono for crisp Turkish mono badges.

p07.title: Packaging Label System
p07.lead: Four reusable components turn a standard product card into a sealed pouch.

callouts.name: ZigzagEdge
callouts.desc: Outward SVG heat-seal strip colored by category.

callouts.name: FlavorStripe
callouts.desc: Pill badge naming the main flavor note.

callouts.name: NetWeightTag
callouts.desc: Monospace net weight chip aligned right.

callouts.name: StarburstBadge
callouts.desc: 20-point price sticker pinned to the image corner.

p08.title: Patterns & Texture
p08.lead: Pure CSS repeating patterns add print texture with zero extra image requests.

patterns.name: halftone-dots
patterns.desc: 10px dot grid behind product cutouts for comic depth.

patterns.name: notebook-grid
patterns.desc: 24px ruled paper grid used on editorial note cards.

patterns.name: TickerStrip
patterns.desc: Continuous butter-yellow marquee with reduced-motion pause.

p09.title: Voice & Tone
p09.lead: Short, direct neighborhood-shop Turkish in informal second person ('sen').
rules: Describe texture and shape directly; skip vague praise.
Keep functional buttons plain: 'Sepete Ekle', 'Sepeti Temizle'.
Limit playful humor to empty states and the 404 bag.

samples.quote: İki renkli, ekşi şeker kaplı yumuşak şeftali halkaları.

p10.title: Product Universe (24 SKUs)
p10.lead: All 24 products sit on pure #FFFFFF cutouts inside uniform 800px and 400px WebP files under 80 KB.
p10.note: Placeholder prices (39–142 TL) and null ingredients/allergens remain visible until verified recipes arrive.

p11.title: Site Map & Flows
p11.lead: Ten routes built with React Router, split into shopping, custom mix, cart, and transparency pages.
flows: Custom Mix: Header → Mix (/mix) → Pick 4–6 portions (50g) → CartDrawer
Checkout: Cart (/cart) → Demo Checkout (/checkout) → Local confirmation

p12.title: Screen: Home Page
p12.lead: Single-column rhythm mixing the hero shelf, category tabs, featured carousel, and RetroDialog.
decisions: Removed duplicate category folder grids so CategoryTabs acts as the single category switcher.
Kept hard offset shadows only on primary CTAs, hero shelf, and product cards.

p13.title: Screen: Shop & Filters
p13.lead: Fuzzy search (Fuse.js), price range slider, sorting, and favorites synced to URL query parameters.
decisions: Syncs ?q=, ?min=, ?max=, ?sort=, and ?fav=1 directly with browser history.
Flattened the filter bar to a border-only surface so product cards lead visually.

p14.title: Screen: Product Detail
p14.lead: Large pouch view paired with option pills, quantity stepper, nutrition label card, and accordions.
decisions: Moved StarburstBadge to the bottom-right of the image box to clear the top zigzag edge.
Displays 'Bilgi eklenecek' explicitly when ingredients or allergens are null.

p15.title: Screen: Custom Mix (/mix)
p15.lead: Pick 4 to 6 items in 50g tasting portions with proportional weight-based pricing.
decisions: Formula: Math.round((price * 50) / netWeightGrams) prevents overcharging heavier packs.
Excluded single-piece lollipops and gum (70–90g) where 50g scoops make no sense.

p16.title: Screen: Cart & Demo Checkout
p16.lead: Persistent Zustand cart (localStorage) with custom mix breakdown, receipt summary, and demo form validation.
decisions: Shipping shows 'Hesaplanmadı' instead of claiming free shipping.
Checkout clearly warns that no card data or real orders are processed.

p17.title: Mobile & Utility Pages
p17.lead: 390px mobile layout with a Radix Dialog drawer menu, plus About, Info, Credits, and 404 pages.
decisions: Built distinct packaging SVG illustrations for empty cart, no search results, and 404.
Separated Wikimedia Commons attributions into a dedicated /credits route.

p18.title: Accessibility & Responsiveness
p18.lead: Tested at 360px, 768px, and 1440px with Lighthouse Accessibility reaching 100.

items.label: Min Contrast
items.value: Lowest pair 5.22:1 (#1E4DD8 on #FFF8EE), all AA pass.

p19.title: AI-Assisted Process
p19.lead: Built through an AI-assisted multi-agent workflow followed by a strict anti-AI cleanup pass.
steps: 3. Anti-AI text & UI cleanup + single-round team voting
4. Independent code-only layout/copy audits & Lighthouse checks
learned: Lucide icons trimmed from 18 down to 8 functional icons.
Unverified freshness, city, and policy claims removed or marked.

p20.title: Limits & Next Steps
p20.lead: What remains a placeholder and what the brand owner must provide before a real launch.
todo: Verified ingredient lists, allergen declarations, and storage notes for all 24 SKUs.
Real unit prices, shipping rates, delivery windows, and return policy copy.
Backend payment/order integration to replace the local demo checkout.
Legal company details and official trademark screening (Class 30).

p21.title: Credits & Licenses
p21.lead: Open-source tools, local fonts, 8 AI-generated images, and 16 Wikimedia Commons photos.
p21.aiNote: 8 product images (sert-seker & jelibon) were generated with AI on #FFFFFF backgrounds. All 16 Wikimedia photos had backgrounds removed/cropped and were converted to 800×800 WebP. CC BY-SA images remain under ShareAlike terms.
